name: Red Ice
desc: All of $market's surface is covered in red crystals whose chemical makup is acutely toxic to human beings. Great care must be taken to avoid unprotected contact and indoor spaces must be filtered and cleaned regularly.

name: Frontier
desc: Far from the cosmopolitan centers of population, mere survival, self-reliance, and only-the-necessities are the rules of the frontier. Increased demand for weapons and supplies, reduced demand for luxury goods.

name: Geothermal
desc: $market has an unusually high amount of geothermal activity, and many hot fissures have split open across its surface. This heat can prove valuable in low energy environments, and the chemical nutrients brought to the surface may aid in farming enterprises.
